methodText: Compute Pressure Index cpx-v1: a weighted sum of six normalised factors (comparable-price premium, advertised availability, 30-day index momentum, power-price stress, facility pipeline relief and demand signals) on a 0-100 scale. It infers pressure on usable supply from advertised asks, facility records, power prices, prediction markets and the feed; it does not measure utilisation and nothing in it is observed ground truth.
